page.overview:
What is Invincible?

Grandparents: Unnamed † (paternal grandfather) Unnamed † (paternal grandmother) Oliver Grayson I † (maternal grandfather) Parents: Nolan Grayson (father) Debbie Grayson (mother) Andressa † (stepmother) Siblings: Oliver Grayson (paternal half-brother) Children:

17 (Season 1) 18 (Season 2) 19-20 (Seasons 3 & 4) 20 (Season 5)

Markus Sebastian "Mark" Grayson is the titular protagonist of the Invincible series. A Viltrumite-Human hybrid, he is the superhero known as Invincible, the son of Nolan Grayson/Omni-Man and Debbie Grayson, the older paternal half-brother of Oliver Grayson, and the maternal grandson of Oliver. He is also the boyfriend of Eve Wilkins/Atom Eve.

At the age of 17, Mark gained his powers and began his superhero journey under the mentorship of his father. After a brief stint with Teen Team, he teamed up with Atom Eve, eventually confessing his feelings to her and beginning a lasting romantic relationship. He also worked alongside the second incarnation of the Guardians of the Globe and the Global Defense Agency to protect Earth from a wide range of threats.

Also known as: Invincible franchise, INV.
